בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדֹר is read under rule 22's distributive repetition: the first דּוֹר takes the English noun, the waw is unrepresented for want of a written connective, and the repeated occurrence is unrepresented; the written כֹּל takes 'all' as a present morpheme.
